title: Invalid or Non-Compliant GSTIN on Tax Invoice
trigger: Invoice seller or buyer GSTIN fails format or Mod-36 checksum validation
legal_reference: Section 122(1)(i) and Section 31 of CGST Act, 2017
penalty_formula: ₹10,000 or an amount equivalent to the tax evaded, whichever is higher

title: Tax Computation Mismatch on Invoice
trigger: Invoice tax amount does not equal taxable value multiplied by tax rate
legal_reference: Section 73 and Section 122(3) of CGST Act, 2017
penalty_formula: 10% of tax amount or ₹10,000, whichever is higher, plus 18% p.a. interest under Section 50

title: Total Amount Mismatch on Invoice
trigger: Invoice total does not equal taxable value plus tax amount
penalty_formula: General penalty up to ₹25,000 under Section 125 of CGST Act

title: Expired Food Business Operator (FSSAI) Licence
trigger: FSSAI licence has passed expiry date without renewal application
legal_reference: Section 31 and Section 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
penalty_formula: ₹100 per day late fee during renewal grace period; operating without valid licence attracts imprisonment up to 6 months and fine up to ₹5,00,000

title: Expired Municipal Trade Licence
penalty_formula: Penalty of 50% to 100% of licence fee plus interest, or business sealing notice
